resources.string: To show you the nearest bus stops and their schedules, we need access to your location while you\'re using the app.\n\nWithout it, the app is useless.
Without location access, the app can’t do its main job – quickly and conveniently showing you the nearest bus stop and its schedule. We kindly ask you to allow access to the location
The app cannot work without the location. If you wish to use the app please allow the location in the settings using the button below
